FULL TEXT:
HIMACHAL ROAD TRANSPORT CORPORATION, SHIMLA-171003
CORRIGENDUM-II
With reference to the advertisement No.IV/2016 dated
23.07.2016 published by HRTC on 24.07.2016 in ‘Divya Himachal’
and ‘The Tribune’ newspapers regarding filling up of 134 posts of
Junior Office Assistant (IT), it is hereby informed that the
candidates possessing qualification equivalent or higher than the
minimum prescribed qualification will also be eligible for applying
for the above posts.
Sd/-
Chief General Manager,
Himachal Road Transport Corporation,
HRTC, Shimla-171003
Date: 28th July, 2016
